The question is undecidable for the languages' class. The quick fix uses a bounded check: `up to 12`.

## Example

```delta error
lang C = cfg { S -> 0 S 1 | ε }
lang P = { w ∈ {0,1}* | count(w,'0') == count(w,'1') }
check C ≡ P
```
